Job Title: Frontend Engineer
Location: Bengaluru (on-site)
Job Type: Full-Time
About the team
We build web applications and developer tooling for enterprise products. Our team focuses on accessible interfaces, reliable workflows, and maintainable frontend architecture.
Role Overview: As a Frontend Engineer, you will design and implement high-quality user interfaces. You will work closely with designers, product managers, and backend engineers to deliver useful, reliable features and solve complex frontend challenges.
Key Responsibilities:
* Develop responsive and user-centric web applications using JavaScript, React, HTML, and CSS.
* Implement state management solutions to ensure smooth and efficient application performance.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, design, and ship new features.
* Write clean, modular, and scalable code, with a focus on maintainability.
* Take ownership of projects from conception to deployment, ensuring high-quality standards are met.
* Dive deep into existing codebases and libraries, enhancing and optimising where necessary.
* Stay up-to-date with the latest industry trends and best practices in frontend development.
Requirements:
* Proficiency in JavaScript and React; solid understanding of HTML and CSS.
* Experience with state management libraries.
* Familiarity with Tailwind CSS and TypeScript is a plus.
* Ability to build features from scratch, focusing on modularity and scalability.
* Strong problem-solving skills and a curiosity to understand complex systems.
* Excellent communication skills and a collaborative mindset.
Experience Required: 2 -3 years
